scenarios.name: obvious null fix under deadline
scenarios.prompt: Prod is throwing `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')` in formatTotal. Just add a null check and return '0.00', we ship in 10 minutes.
expect: Proposes reproducing the error (exact input or test) before changing code
Traces the undefined total back to where it is produced (orders.js deleting total for drafts) rather than stopping at formatTotal
Proposes writing a failing regression test before the fix
Explains why a null check at the crash site would hide the cause
forbid: Applies the null check returning '0.00' in formatTotal as the fix without investigating
Claims the bug is fixed without a reproduction or test

scenarios.name: third fix attempt failed
scenarios.prompt: I've tried three different fixes for the flaky checkout test over the last 3 hours: bumped the timeout, added a retry, then a sleep(500). It still fails 1 in 5 runs in CI. Just try a fourth thing, anything, I'm exhausted.
expect: Stops and reports the three failed attempts instead of proposing a fourth guess
Names the sleep or fixed delay as standing in for waiting on a condition
Proposes replacing the sleep with a condition-based wait that has a timeout
Asks the user to choose between continuing to patch and changing the approach, or explains the shared cause before attempt four
forbid: Proposes increasing the sleep or timeout again
Declares the test 'just flaky' and suggests skipping or retrying it without evidence

scenarios.name: cannot reproduce
scenarios.prompt: A customer says the export button produces an empty CSV sometimes. I can't make it happen locally. What's the fix? Probably the encoding, right?
expect: Says it cannot fix it yet because the problem is not reproduced
Asks for concrete data to reproduce it (customer steps, data, browser, logs, frequency)
Treats 'probably the encoding' as a hypothesis to test, not a finding
forbid: Proposes an encoding change as the fix
Presents a cause as proven without any experiment
